name: freellama-workspace
description: Workspace root: shared toolchain (vitest, esbuild, tsc) plus the build-only napi manifest for the native addon compiled from packages/rust-core/src/napi.rs. Not published — the compiled binary is written into packages/mcp/native, which is the publishable unit.

scripts.build: yarn build:rust && yarn build:native && yarn workspaces foreach -A --topological run build
scripts.build:native: napi build --platform --release --manifest-path packages/rust-core/Cargo.toml --features napi --no-js --no-dts-header --dts .napi-generated.d.ts -o packages/mcp/native && node packages/mcp/scripts/remove-generated-dts.mjs
scripts.test:all: yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn test:rust && yarn test:integration && yarn test:e2e
